blurb: Crescent Lake Bible Camp has the facilities you need for the perfect meeting, retreat or getaway! From rustic cabins and tent camping to modern facilities on par with area hotels, we have the lodging to fit your needs. We can accommodate groups as small as one to over 200. We offer meeting spaces that can seat up to 200 people comfortably, with additional break-out rooms to allow small groups to meet privately.
